2400.commentary: (DNt) atītakāl'attho pāḷiyaṃ hoti-saddo yogavibhāgena, taṃkāl'āpekkhāya vā evaṃ vuttaṃ, tadā hotī'ti attho.

examples.text: idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti, yadā bhagavā taṃ addhānamaggaṃ paṭipanno, tadā suppiyo'pi paribbājako paṭipanno ahosī'ti. atītakāl'attho h'ettha hoti-saddo.

2402.meaning1: fact of having gone past; fact of having moved beyond
2402.commentary: (VISMa) cakkhussa āpāthaṃ atītattā ajjhoharitabbo hotī'ti ukkaṃsagataṃ tassa paṭikkūlabhāvaṃ vibhāveti.

examples.text: so evaṃ vicuṇṇitamakkhito taṅ'khaṇaññ'eva antarahita-vaṇṇa-gandha-saṅkhāra-viseso suvānadoṇiyaṃ ṭhitasuvānavamathu viya paramajegucchabhāvaṃ upagacchati. evarūpo'pi samāno cakkhussa āpāthaṃ atītattā ajjhoharitabbo hotī'ti evaṃ paribhogato paṭikkūlatā paccavekkhitabbā.
pamuñcasī'ti atīt'atthe vattamānavacanaṃ.

2404.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of atītamaddha
2404.construction:
atīta + aṃ + addha + ānaṃ
atītamaddhā + ānaṃ

examples.text: evaṃrūpo ahosiṃ atītam'addhānan'ti, iti vā hi, bhikkhave, anussaramāno rūpaṃ'y'eva anussarati
ye hi keci, rāhula, atītam'addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kāyakammaṃ parisodhesuṃ… sabbe te evam'evaṃ paccavekkhitvā paccavekkhitvā kāyakammaṃ parisodhesuṃ

2407.meaning1: with a dead teacher; whose teacher has passed away
2407.commentary: (DNt) atīto satthā ettha, etassā'ti vā atītasatthukaṃ yathā bahukattuko'ti. padhānaṃ vacanaṃ pāvacanaṃ.

examples.text: siyā kho pan'ānanda, tumhākaṃ evam'assa, atītasatthukaṃ pāvacanaṃ, n'atthi no satthā'ti.

2409.meaning1: regretting the past; bemoaning the past

examples.text: anāgatappajappāya, atītass'ānusocanā, etena bālā sussanti, naḷo'va harito luto'ti.

2410.commentary: (SNt) ten'āha anāgat'atthe atītavacanan'ti. n'ājjhagā'ti hi atītaṃ, na gamissatī'ti etasmiṃ atthe.

2411.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of atīta
2411.commentary: (PMa) atītam'pi addhānan'ti atikkantam'pi kālaṃ. anāgatam'pi addhānan'ti appattam'pi kālaṃ.

examples.text: katamāni, bhikkhave, sattasattari ñāṇavatthūni? jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇan'ti ñāṇaṃ, asati jātiyā n'atthi jarāmaraṇan'ti ñāṇaṃ, atītam'pi addhānaṃ jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇan'ti ñāṇaṃ, asati jātiyā n'atthi jarāmaraṇan'ti ñāṇaṃ, anāgatam'pi addhānaṃ jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇan'ti ñāṇaṃ…
atītaṃ vā, bhikkhave, addhānaṃ ārabbha kathaṃ katheyya, evaṃ ahosi atītam'addhānan'ti.
bahūni puttasatāni, ñātisaṅghasatāni ca, khāditāni atīt'aṃse, mama tuyhañ'ca brāhmaṇa.

tatr'āyasmantānaṃ nigaṇṭhānaṃ kā atīt'aṃse satthari saddhā, kā ruci, ko anussavo, ko ākāraparivitakko, kā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantī'ti. evaṃvādī kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhesu na kañci sahadhammikaṃ vādapaṭihāraṃ samanupassāmi.

2414.commentary: (SNa) atīt'ānāgate nayaṃ netī'ti ye kho kecī'ti-ādinā nayena atīte ca anāgate ca nayaṃ neti.

examples.text: so iminā dhammena diṭṭhena viditena akālikena pattena pariyogāḷhena atīt'ānāgatena yaṃ neti.

2415.meaning1: in the past, the future, and the present
2415.compound: dvanda (atīta ca anāgata ca paccuppanna ca)

examples.text: yaṃ papañceti tatonidānaṃ purisaṃ papañcasaññāsaṅkhā samudācaranti atīt'ānāgatapaccuppannesu cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu
atha kho bhagavā apaloketvā āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ āmantesi, yaṃ kiñci, rāhula, rūpaṃ, atīt'ānāgatapaccuppannaṃ… sabbaṃ rūpaṃ, n'etaṃ mama

2416.grammar: ind, adv, loc sg of atītānāgata, comp
2416.meaning1: in the past and in the future; previously and currently
2416.meaning2: in the past and in the future
2416.commentary: (SNa) atīt'ānāgate nayaṃ netī'ti ye kho kecī'ti-ādinā nayena atīte ca anāgate ca nayaṃ n'eti.

examples.text: iminā tvaṃ dhammena diṭṭhena viditena akālikena pattena pariyogāḷhena atīt'ānāgate nayaṃ nehi

2417.grammar: ind, adv, loc sg of atīta
2417.meaning1: once upon a time; in the past

examples.text: atīte kira kassapasammāsambuddhakāle gāmavāsī eko kuṭumbiko ekassa therassa vihāraṃ katvā taṃ tattha viharantaṃ catūhi paccayehi upaṭṭhahi
atīte bārāṇasiyaṃ brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto kāsigāmake kumbhakārakule nibbattitvā kumbhakārakammaṃ katvā puttadāraṃ posesi.

2418.construction:
na > a + √tir > tīr + *a + ka
atīra + ka

examples.text: ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, cunda, vijjati, yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, atītaṃ kho addhānaṃ ārabbha samaṇo gotamo atīrakaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paññapeti, no ca kho anāgataṃ addhānaṃ ārabbha atīrakaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paññapeti, ta'y'idaṃ kiṃsu ta'y'idaṃ kathaṃsū'ti?

2419.meaning1: beyond sight of the shore; with land out of sight

2420.meaning1: not seeing the shore; beyond sight of the shore-line
2420.meaning2: no longer seeing the shore; beyond sight of the shore-line

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, ahaṃ, kevaṭṭa, taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavocaṃ, bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhu, sāmuddikā vāṇijā tīradassiṃ sakuṇaṃ gahetvā nāvāya samuddaṃ ajjhogāhanti. te atīradakkhiniyā nāvāya tīradassiṃ sakuṇaṃ muñcanti.

2421.meaning1: not seeing the near shore; (comm) not seeing the cycle of existence
2421.commentary: (SNa) atīradassī'ti tīraṃ vuccati vaṭṭaṃ, taṃ na passati.

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano vedanābandhanabaddho santarabāhirabandhanabaddho atīradassī apāradassī, baddho jīyati baddho mīyati baddho asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ gacchati.

2423.commentary: (VVa) atīva saṅgatā'ti ativiya suṭṭhu saṅgatā suphassitā nibbivarā.

examples.text: purato pacchato vā'pi, aparo ce na vijjati, atīva phāsu bhavati, ekassa vasato vane.

2424.meaning2: not empty; not hollow; not void; not in vain
2424.commentary: (ANt) arittajjhāno'ti avirahitajjhāno. atucchajjhāno'ti jhānena atuccho. cāgo vā vevacanan'ti āha, apariccattajjhāno'ti.

examples.text: arittajjhāno'ti atucchajjhāno apariccattajjhāno vā. viharatī'ti iriyati pavattati pāleti yapeti yāpeti carati viharati.
ātaṅkaphassena khudāya phuṭṭho, sītaṃ atuṇhaṃ adhivāsayeyya, so tehi phuṭṭho bahudhā anoko, vīriyaṃ parakkammadaḷhaṃ kareyya.
porāṇam'etaṃ atula, n'etaṃ ajjatanām'iva, nindanti tuṇhim'āsīnaṃ, nindanti bahubhāṇinaṃ, mitabhāṇim'pi nindanti, n'atthi loke anindito.
tuvañ'ca bhante anukampakaṃ viduṃ, upecca vandiṃ kusalañ'ca pucchisaṃ, tato te ucchussa adāsi khaṇḍikaṃ, pasannacitā atulāya pītiyā'ti.

2428.commentary: (SNa) na tulaṃ, na vā tulaṃ sadisam'assa aññaṃ lokiyakammaṃ atthī'ti atulaṃ.

examples.text: taṇhacchidassa buddhassa, vītadhūmassa anupalittassa, āhuneyyassa yakkhassa, uttamapuggalassa atulassa, mahato yas'aggapattassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmī'ti.

2430.grammar: adj, from na tikicchā, neg, desid

examples.text: tam'enaṃ tvaṃ evaṃ vadeyyāsi, atha kiñ'carahi te, bhante, devadatto byākato, āpāyiko devadatto, nerayiko devadatto, kappaṭṭho devadatto, atekiccho devadatto'ti?

mātā jīvitā voropitā hoti, pitā jīvitā voropito hoti, arahaṃ jīvitā voropito hoti, tathāgatassa duṭṭhena cittena lohitaṃ uppāditaṃ hoti, saṅgho bhinno hoti. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca āpāyikā nerayikā parikuppā atekicchā'ti.

2431.grammar: adj, from na tikicchā, neg, desid
2431.meaning2: who can not be pardoned; unrehabilitatable

2432.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of ima
2432.meaning1: from here; from this; because of this

examples.text: yattha āpo ca pathavī, tejo vāyo na gādhati, ato sarā nivattanti, ettha vaṭṭaṃ na vattati, ettha nāmañ'ca rūpañ'ca, asesaṃ uparujjhatī't

2433.commentary: (SNPa) attā nirattā na hi tassa atthī'ti tassa hi attadiṭṭhi vā ucchedadiṭṭhi vā n'atthi, gahaṇaṃ muñcanaṃ vā'pi attanirattasaññitaṃ n'atthi.

examples.text: saṅkhārā ca h'idaṃ, bhikkhave, attā abhavissaṃsu, na'y'idaṃ saṅkhārā ābādhāya saṃvatteyyuṃ, labbhetha ca saṅkhāresu, evaṃ me saṅkhārā hontu, evaṃ me saṅkhārā mā ahesun'ti.
attā hi attano nātho, attā hi attano gati, tasmā saññamay'attānaṃ, assaṃ bhadraṃ'va vāṇijo.

ahosiṃ ahaṃ, bho raṭṭhapāla, vīsativass'uddesiko'pi paṇṇavīsativass'uddesiko'pi hatthismim'pi katāvī assasmim'pi katāvī rathasmim'pi katāvī dhanusmim'pi katāvī tharusmim'pi katāvī ūrubalī bāhubalī alam'atto saṅgām'āvacaro.

2435.commentary: (SNPa) attā nirattā na hi tassa atthī'ti tassa hi attadiṭṭhi vā ucchedadiṭṭhi vā n'atthi, gahaṇaṃ muñcanaṃ vā'pi attanirattasaññitaṃ n'atthi.

examples.text: upayo hi dhammesu upeti vādaṃ, anūpayaṃ kena kathaṃ vadeyya, attaṃ nirattaṃ na hi tassa atthi, adhosi so diṭṭhim'idh'eva sabban'ti.
na brāhmaṇo aññato suddhim'āha, diṭṭhe sute sīlavate mute vā, puññe ca pāpe ca anūpalitto, attañ'jaho na'y'idha pakubbamāno.
attadaṇḍā bhayaṃ jātaṃ, janaṃ passatha medhagaṃ, saṃvegaṃ kittayissāmi, yathā saṃvijitaṃ mayā.
aviruddhaṃ viruddhesu, attadaṇḍesu nibbutaṃ, sādānesu anādānaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
333, 344. attaṃ nassa tappurise.
nassa padassa tappurise uttarapade attaṃ hoti. nabrāhmaṇo abrāhmaṇo, avasalo, abhikkhu, apañcavassaṃ, apañcagavaṃ.
na'y'idaṃ attakataṃ bimbaṃ, na'y'idaṃ parakataṃ aghaṃ, hetuṃ paṭicca sambhūtaṃ, hetubhaṅgā nirujjhati.
sace tvaṃ dhanakāmo'si, bhūridatto padassati, maññe attakataṃ veraṃ, naciraṃ vedayissasi.

2439.meaning1: desiring one's own good; seeking one's own best interests; wanting self-liberation

examples.text: sādhikam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, diyaḍḍhasikkhāpadasataṃ anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati yattha attakāmā kulaputtā sikkhanti.
sabbā disā anuparigamma cetasā, n'ev'ajjhagā piyataram'attanā kvaci, evaṃ piyo puthu attā paresaṃ, tasmā na hiṃse param'attakāmo'ti.

2440.meaning1: one's own pleasure; sex for oneself
2440.commentary: (VIN 1.2.4) attakāman'ti attano kāmaṃ attano hetuṃ attano adhippāyaṃ attano pāricariyaṃ.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmassa santike attakāmapāricariyāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyya… methun'upasaṃhitena, saṅgh'ādiseso.

2441.meaning1: rule about (speaking in praise of) attending to one's sexual pleasure; Saṅghādisesa 4

2442.meaning1: ministering to oneself with sex; attending to one's sexual pleasure; taking care of one's sexual needs
2442.commentary: (VINa) attakāmapāricariyāyā'ti methunadhammasaṅkhātena kāmena pāricariyā kāmapāricariyā. attano atthāya kāmapāricariyā attakāmapāricariyā

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmassa santike attakāmapāricariyāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyya… methun'upasaṃhitena, saṅgh'ādiseso.

2443.meaning1: desiring one's own good; seeking one's own best interests; wanting self-liberation

examples.text: disvāna bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, mā, samaṇa, etaṃ dāyaṃ pāvisi. sant'ettha tayo kulaputtā attakāmarūpā viharanti. mā tesaṃ aphāsum'akāsī'ti.

2444.meaning1: agency in oneself; action performed by oneself
2444.commentary: (DNa) attakāre'ti attakāro. yena attanā katakammena ime sattā devattam'pi mārattam'pi brahmattam'pi sāvakabodhim'pi paccekabodhim'pi sabbaññutam'pi pāpuṇanti, tam'pi paṭikkhipati.

examples.text: ahañ'hi, bho gotama, evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhi, n'atthi attakāro, n'atthi parakāro'ti. m'āhaṃ, brāhmaṇa, evaṃvādiṃ evaṃdiṭṭhiṃ addasaṃ vā assosiṃ vā.

2445.meaning1: with agency in oneself; doing an action performed by oneself

examples.text: na kāmasukham'anuyuñjeyya hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, na ca attakilamatha-anuyogam'anuyuñjeyya dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ.
yo c'āyaṃ attakilamatha-anuyogo dukkho anariyo anatthasañhito.
na kāmasukham'anuyuñjeyya hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, na ca attakilamath'ānuyogam'anuyuñjeyya dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ.
yo c'āyaṃ attakilamath'ānuyogo dukkho anariyo anatthasañhito.

2449.meaning1: engages in the practice of self-mortification

examples.text: na kāmasukham'anuyuñjeyya hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, na ca attakilamath'ānuyogam'anuyuñjeyya dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ. ete kho, bhikkhave, ubho ante anupagamma majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā, cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.

2450.meaning1: devoted to the practice of self-mortification

examples.text: na ca, bhante, bhagavā kāmesu kāmasukhallik'ānuyogam'anuyutto hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, na ca attakilamath'ānuyogam'anuyutto dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ.

2451.meaning1: who criticizes oneself; who blames oneself
2451.commentary: (NIDD1) attagarahī'ti dvīhi kāraṇehi attānaṃ garahati, katattā ca akatattā ca. (VINa) attagarahino mayan'ti attānam'eva mayaṃ garahāma, attano dosaṃ dema.

examples.text: ubhosu antesu vineyya chandaṃ, phassaṃ pariññāya anānugiddho, yadattagarahī tadakubbamāno, na lippatī diṭṭhasutesu dhīro.

ye'pi samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakā sabrahmacārīhi sampayojetvā sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattanti te'pi satthu c'eva vaṇṇavādino honti, dhammassa ca vaṇṇavādino honti, saṅghassa ca vaṇṇavādino honti, attagarahino'y'eva honti anaññagarahino

2452.commentary: (DHPa) so'ti so tvaṃ, bhikkhu, evaṃ sante attanā'va guttatāya attagutto.

examples.text: attanā coday'attānaṃ, paṭimaṃsetha attanā, so attagutto satimā, sukhaṃ bhikkhu vihāhisi.

2453.meaning1: protected by oneself; looking after oneself
2453.commentary: (ANa) attagutto'ti attanā'va gutto rakkhito, attānaṃ vā gopetuṃ rakkhituṃ samattho.

examples.text: na kho pan'etaṃ, ācariya, evaṃ bhavissati. tvaṃ, ācariya, attānaṃ rakkha, ahaṃ attānaṃ rakkhissāmi. evaṃ mayaṃ attaguttā attarakkhitā sippāni c'eva dassessāma, lābhañ'ca lacchāma, sotthinā ca caṇḍālavaṃsā orohissāmā'ti.
anujānāmi, bhikkhave, imāni cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena pharituṃ attaguttiyā attarakkhāya attaparittāyā'ti.
yo sāsanaṃ arahataṃ, ariyānaṃ dhammajīvinaṃ, paṭikkosati dummedho, diṭṭhiṃ nissāya pāpikaṃ, phalāni kaṭṭhakass'eva, attaghātāya phallati.

2457.meaning2: with oneself as the fourth; with three others

examples.text: sve dān'āhaṃ sake nivesane bhagavato vādaṃ āropessāmī'ti bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, adhivāsetu me, bhante, bhagavā svātanāya attacatuttho bhattan'ti.
attanā hi kataṃ pāpaṃ, attajaṃ attasambhavaṃ, abhimatthati dummedhaṃ, vajiraṃ'v'asmamayaṃ maṇiṃ.

2460.meaning1: (of a discourse's origin) on account of one's personal inclination
2460.meaning2: sutta delivered according to the speaker's inclination
2460.commentary: (DNt) attano ajjhāsayo att'ajjhāsayo, so assa atthi suttadesanā-kāraṇabhūto'ti att'ajjhāsayo. attano ajjhāsayo etassā'ti vā att'ajjhāsayo. par'ajjhāsayo'ti etthā'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: tattha yāni suttāni bhagavā parehi anajjhiṭṭho kevalaṃ attano ajjhāsayeneva kathesi, seyyath'idaṃ, ākaṅkheyyasuttaṃ, vatthasuttaṃ, mahāsatipaṭṭhānaṃ, mahāsaḷāyatanavibhaṅgasuttaṃ, ariyavaṃsasuttaṃ, sammappadhānasuttantahārako, iddhipādaindriyabalabojjhaṅgamaggaṅgasuttantahārakoti evam'ādīni, tesaṃ att'ajjhāsayo nikkhepo.

2461.meaning1: who knows oneself; who understands oneself
2461.commentary: (DNa) ettako'mhi sīlena samādhinā paññāyā'ti evaṃ attānaṃ jānātī'ti attaññū.

examples.text: satta sappurisadhammā, idh'āvuso, bhikkhu dhammaññū ca hoti atthaññū ca attaññū ca mattaññū ca kālaññū ca parisaññū ca puggalaññū ca.

2462.meaning2: looking (only) after one's own profit or interest; (who is) wise as to his own advantage

2463.meaning1: in the sense of being a self

2464.meaning2: wise only for oneself; concerned with oneself only (so sometimes commentaries); (same as atta)

2465.commentary: (NIDD2a) sabb'attatāyā'ti sabbesu hīna-majjhima-ukkaṭṭha-mitta-sapatta-majjhattānippabhedesu attatāya, ayaṃ parasatto'ti vibhāgaṃ akatvā attasamatāyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: iti uddham'adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabb'attatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.

2466.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of atta, atta group

examples.text: varaṃ bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano imaṃ cātumahābhūtikaṃ kāyaṃ attato upagaccheyya na tv'eva cittaṃ
idha, gahapati, assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto rūpaṃ attato samanupassati

2467.meaning2: one's own profit or interest; one's own goal

2468.meaning1: one's own welfare; personal benefit; personal profit
2468.commentary: (ANa) att'attham'pī'ti-ādīsu arahattasaṅkhāto attano attho att'attho nāma, paccayadāyakānaṃ attho par'attho nāma, sv'eva duvidho ubhayattho nāma.

examples.text: att'attham'pi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati, par'attham'pi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati, ubhay'attham'pi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati
att'atthaṃ vā ñassati par'atthaṃ vā ñassati ubhay'atthaṃ vā ñassati uttariṃ vā manussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-visesaṃ sacchikarissatī'ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

2470.commentary: (SNPa) yaṃ lokassa diṭṭhadhammikaṃ vā samparāyikaṃ vā bhayaṃ jātaṃ, taṃ sabbaṃ attadaṇḍā bhayaṃ jātaṃ attano duccaritakāraṇā jātaṃ

examples.text: attadaṇḍā bhayaṃ jātaṃ, janaṃ passatha medhagaṃ, saṃvegaṃ kittayissāmi, yathā saṃvijitaṃ mayā.
aviruddhaṃ viruddhesu, attadaṇḍesu nibbutaṃ, sādānesu anādānaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

2473.meaning1: one's own welfare; personal benefit; personal profit

examples.text: atta'd'atthaṃ par'atthena, bahunā'pi na hāpaye, atta'd'attham'abhiññāya, sadatthapasuto siyā.

2474.commentary: (ANa) attadantan'ti attanā'y'eva dantaṃ, na aññehi damathaṃ upanītaṃ.

examples.text: attadantassa posassa, niccaṃ saññatacārino, n'eva devo na gandhabbo, na māro saha brahmunā, jitaṃ apajitaṃ kayirā, tathārūpassa jantuno.
varam'assatarā dantā, ājānīyā ca sindhavā, kuñjarā ca mahānāgā, attadanto tato varaṃ.

2476.commentary: (DNa) attadīpā'ti mahāsamuddagatadīpaṃ viya attānaṃ dīpaṃ patiṭṭhaṃ katvā viharatha.

examples.text: tasmā't'iha bhikkhave attadīpā viharatha

2477.meaning1: fact of taking refuge in oneself; fact of being self-reliant

2479.meaning2: Chapter 5 of the Khandhasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 3 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

2480.meaning2: one's own suffering; one's own pain
2480.commentary: (JAa) yo attadukkhenā'ti, samma abhipāraka, yo attano dukkhena pīḷito taṃ parassa dahati, attano sarīrato apanetvā parassa sarīre khipati, parassa vā sukhena attano sukhaṃ dahati, parassa sukhaṃ gahetvā attani pakkhipati, attano dukkhaṃ harissāmī'ti paraṃ dukkhitaṃ karoti, attānaṃ sukhessāmī'ti paraṃ dukkhitaṃ karoti, attānaṃ sukhessāmī'ti parassa sukhaṃ nāseti, na so dhammaṃ jānāti. yo pana evaṃ jānāti yath'ev'idaṃ mayhaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ, tathā paresan'ti, sa vedi dhammaṃ jānāti nāmā'ti ayam'etissā gāthāya attho.

examples.text: yo attadukkhena parassa dukkhaṃ, sukhena vā attasukhaṃ dahāti, yath'ev'idaṃ mayha tathā paresaṃ, yo evaṃ jānāti sa vedi dhammaṃ.

2481.meaning2: with oneself as the second; with a companion

examples.text: evaṃ, bhante'ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā nivāsetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya attadutiyo kusināraṃ pāvisi.

2483.meaning2: with the self, with oneself as master; controlled by the self

2485.grammar: masc, acc sg of atta, atta group
2485.meaning1: self; himself; herself; itself; yourself; oneself (object)

examples.text: hananti bhogā dummedhaṃ, no ca pāragavesino, bhogataṇhāya dummedho, hanti aññ'eva attanaṃ.

2486.grammar: masc, instr sg of atta, atta group

examples.text: yadā ca attanā vedi, muni monena brāhmaṇo, atha rūpā arūpā ca, sukhadukkhā pamuccatī'ti.
attā hi attano nātho, ko hi nātho paro siyā, attanā hi sudantena, nāthaṃ labhati dullabhaṃ.

2487.grammar: masc, abl sg of atta, atta group

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena rājā pasenadi kosalo mallikāya deviyā saddhiṃ uparipāsādavaragato hoti. atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo mallikaṃ deviṃ etadavoca, atthi nu kho te, mallike, koc'añño attanā piyataro'ti?

2488.meaning1: by oneself for oneself; by oneself to oneself

examples.text: yaṃnūn'āhaṃ attanā'va attano anabhiratiṃ vinodetvā abhiratiṃ uppādeyyan'ti
kiñ'c'āpi te evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, piyo no attā'ti, atha kho tesaṃ appiyo attā. taṃ kissa hetu? yañ'hi appiyo appiyassa kareyya, taṃ te attanā'va attano karonti, tasmā tesaṃ appiyo attā.
so ākaṅkhamāno attanā'va attānaṃ byākareyya, khīṇanirayo'mhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇ'āpāyaduggativinipāto sot'āpanno'ham'asmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo'ti
atthi me attā'ti vā assa saccato thetato diṭṭhi uppajjati, n'atthi me attā'ti vā assa saccato thetato diṭṭhi uppajjati, attanā'va attānaṃ sañjānāmī'ti vā assa saccato thetato diṭṭhi uppajjati

2490.grammar: masc, loc sg of atta, atta group

examples.text: rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā rūpaṃ, rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ, ahaṃ rūpaṃ, mama rūpan'ti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti.
pakappitā saṅkhatā yassa dhammā, purakkhatā santi avīvadātā, yadattani passati ānisaṃsaṃ, taṃ nissito kuppapaṭicca santiṃ.

2491.grammar: masc, loc sg of atta, atta group, loc abs

examples.text: attani vā, bhikkhave, sati attaniyaṃ me'ti assā'ti? evaṃ, bhante. attaniye vā, bhikkhave, sati attā me'ti assā'ti? evaṃ, bhante.

attani ca, bhikkhave, attaniye ca saccato thetato anupalabbhamāne, yam'pi taṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ, so loko so attā, so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassāmī'ti, nan'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kevalo paripūro bāladhammo'ti?

2492.meaning1: one's own; belonging to oneself; fit to be a self

examples.text: kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, suñño loko'ti vuccatī'ti? yasmā ca kho, ānanda, suññaṃ attena vā attaniyena vā tasmā suñño loko'ti vuccati.
attani vā, bhikkhave, sati attaniyaṃ me'ti assā'ti? evaṃ, bhante. attaniye vā, bhikkhave, sati attā me'ti assā'ti? evaṃ, bhante.

2493.grammar: masc, loc sg of atta, atta group, irreg form of attani

examples.text: yadattanī passati ānisaṃsaṃ, diṭṭhe sute sīlavate mute vā, tadeva so tattha samuggahāya, nihīnato passati sabbam'aññaṃ.

2494.meaning2: belonging to one's self one's own; belonging to an self or soul; what belongs to one's self; what belongs to an (enduring) self or soul

2497.meaning2: intent upon oneself or one's own interest

2499.meaning1: for oneself; for one's own sake; for one's own benefit

examples.text: yāni kho pana tāni paṇītabhojanāni, seyyath'idaṃ, sappi, navanītaṃ, telaṃ, madhu, phāṇitaṃ, maccho, maṃsaṃ, khīraṃ, dadhi. yo pana bhikkhu evarūpāni paṇītabhojanāni agilāno attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
agilāno attano atthāya viññāpeti, payoge dukkaṭaṃ. paṭilābhena bhuñjissāmī'ti paṭiggaṇhāti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ajjhohāre ajjhohāre āpatti pācittiyassa.
